steps: At Willow's suggestion, you head to Philae's underground market, where the Tech Convention is about to begin. From the Trekkers gathered there, you learn that Sparkla is currently locked up in prison.
The underground market? Neo Grace Organization?

All the Neo Solution and Neo-tech devices circulating on the market are made and sold by us at the Neo Grace Organization, y'know~==W== Take Sparkla and me, for example. She makes the stuff, and I sell it ♪
Since anything related to Neo-tech can't exactly be sold out in the open, we do our business quietly with Trekkers in the underground market instead~
Aren't you worried that the Imperial Guard will shut you down?

Oh hoho, it's not like we're some heinous villain organization.==W== We're just inventing things and running a small business.==W== Even if we run into the Imperial Guard, as long as we can get away, it's all good~
So you ARE being hunted by the Imperial Guard then?!
Oh, relax!==W== These days the Imperial Guard only follows procedure anyway. There are way too many people using Neo-tech for them to arrest everyone one by one.
As long as you don't use it blatantly right in front of them, there's absolutely no problem!
Though... There was one thing boss Willow mentioned that's been bothering me a little...
Yep, yep.==W== As far as I know, unless something HUGE happens, those people would never willingly show themselves~
If the rumors are true, then it's probably because of "that incident"...==W== But I haven't heard anything on my end~==W== Either way, guess we'll have to head to Philae and see for ourselves.
Then let's meet up in Philae.
Trekkers and Neo-tech artisans gathering in one place...==W== Mm~ I smell business opportunities everywhere~ Looks like Dorra herself is calling out to me,==W== fufufu~♪
... You didn't forget why we came here in the first place, did you?
Ah, right right!==W== Finding Sparkla!!==W== Don't worry, I didn't forget!
We haven't even entered the city yet, and I've already seen more Trekkers out here than back at camp.
... people carrying giant boxes full of tools and weird equipment...
Bloc, are those the Neo-tech artisans you mentioned?
Welcome, welcome~ Take your time browsing~ I'm sure we've got something perfect for you~
And if you really can't decide, Bloc can always give you a recommendation too, oh hoho~♪

I-I really AM gathering intel too! Setting up a stall is market research at its core!==W== Besides, look at all this Dorra practically walking right up to me...==W== It'd be a waste not to take it, ahahaha~
A-Anyway! I've already gathered some useful information!==W== Follow me, Boss.
She's the favorite to win the convention this time? Then I'm betting on her too!
What about the other contestants? Those odds are crazy high!
It's so lively... What's going on?
This is exactly why all those Neo artisans gathered together in the first place—==W==the "Tech Convention"!!
Normally, the people from Neo Grace Organization are scattered all across Nova. Especially those artisans. They'd rather lock themselves in their workshops inventing stuff all day.
But whenever someone develops a new technology or creates some insanely impressive invention,==W== everyone gathers together to exchange information and show off their skills.
Isn't this supposed to be an internal Neo Grace Organization event? Why are there so many Trekkers here placing bets?
Well~ Usually it's just a small gathering between artisans. It normally wouldn't get this flashy with gambling and everything~ As for why it turned into this...
That part? I already investigated it before you arrived.
And you already uncovered more information too...==W== As expected of the head of Emor's Trekkers' House!

... Ahem.==W== According to my investigation, this Tech Convention is different from the previous ones.==W== Apparently, a major investor offered an enormous prize pool and gathered all the artisans together.
The investor's goal, supposedly, is to develop an automaton capable of surviving in the Wilds. That's why they invited so many outstanding artisans specializing in that field.
In addition, the convention opened a betting pool, so even Trekkers who normally have no interest in Neo Grace Organization products started paying attention.
Boss, I'm sure you've already noticed.==W== Miss Sparkla's name is on the betting list too, which confirms that she was invited as well.
So once the convention starts, we'll be able to meet Sparkla, right?==W== In that case, I guess the commission is basically resolved already.
Looks like it~ Once we find Sparkla, I'll introduce you to her, Boss.
Well then~ Since the commission is practically settled! Time for me to go make a fortune...==W== I mean, time to support my dear friend Sparkla~
Boss, and boss Willow, see you later!==W==
Hey there, mister! I wanna place a bet too!
And of course I'm betting on the most talented artisan there is! All in on Sparkla!
This entire bag of Dorra, plus ...==W== five Neo Coins! I'm putting EVERYTHING on her!
Miss, are you absolutely sure?==W== Once the bet's placed, there's no taking it back.
Of course I am! It's Sparkla we're talking about here.==W== She's practically guaranteed to win. I don't even need to look at the odds.
Whoa, now that's gutsy. Someone actually bet on the contestant with the highest odds.
Hehehe...==W== Huh? Wait, what did you just say? The highest odds?==W== T-That can't be right~
What? Haven't you heard?==W== We just got word—Sparkla got arrested by the Imperial Guard, so she can't participate in the convention anymore.
Wha-==W==what the heck is that idiot doingggg?!
Iris, Amber, looks like Boss already tracked down Sparkla's whereabouts.
That's great. Let's hurry and regroup with them.
Huh?==W== That statue ... feels kinda familiar...==W== Wait, Bloc?!
It's over... It's ALL OVER...==W== Boss, save me!!!
So Miss Sparkla was locked up by the Imperial Guard?
Didn't you say earlier that the Imperial Guard couldn't be bothered with this stuff?
Well... This is my first time dealing with something like this too...==W== I just bet my entire life savings on Sparkla... My ENTIRE life savings...
If Sparkla can't compete in two days, then all the Dorra I worked so hard to save up is gonna go completely==W== down==W== the drain!
Boss, please ...==W== help me out here?
Well... Gambling kinda means accepting the risk, right? Shouldn't this be your personal responsibility, Bloc...?
I can increase the commission fee!==W== As long as Sparkla makes it to the convention, first place is basically guaranteed.
How about this then...==W== We split the winnings fifty-fifty!!==W== Even half would still be an absolutely massive fortune!
I checked already. The prize money really is substantial. Honestly, even I'm a little tempted.==B====W==
... Alright. Then let's give it a shot.==W== No time to waste. To avoid drawing too much attention,==W== Noya,==W== Bloc, and I will infiltrate the place ourselves.
Everyone else, stay on standby in Ash District and wait for my signal.
Boss, Bloc, all the troublesome guards are taken care of!
Dorra really is powerful. Noya's moving way more aggressively than usual...
We really did just charge straight into an infiltration mission on impulse...==W== But now that I think about it, maybe we're being way too reckless... This should be fine... Hopefully...
Not in this room...==W== Not here either...==W== Sparkla, where are you—
What is that?! Should I take it out?
Phew... Good thing Miss Noya asked first.==W== If Rabbit Pie got hurt, we'd be in serious trouble~
Whoa,==W== the craftsmanship is incredible! And it's so soft too!==W== This rabbit is adorable~
Allow me to properly introduce her—==W==this is Rabbit Pie, Sparkla's custom-made adorable mechanical rabbit~
If Rabbit Pie is here, then Sparkla must be nearby too~
And Rabbit Pie can answer simple questions too. Here, let me show you.==W== Rabbit Pie, tell us where your master is.
Oooh~ What a good little bunny ♪
So she can even create a mechanical rabbit like this... No wonder Bloc said she was guaranteed to win first place.
What is it, Rabbit Pie? Did we get visitors?
:p Correct. Identified as Bloc, plus two unidentified individuals.
Preparing tea.==W== Estimated completion time: three minutes.
Rabbit Pie is such a good bunny~
Bloc, would you like an apple before tea?
Mhm, yes yes~♪==W== Nom nom...==W== Whoa, this apple is super sweet!
No no no, wait! Sparkla, is now really the time to casually sit around eating apples?!
Then would you rather see this half-finished puppy? Materials are limited in prison, so I only managed to make the body so far—
THAT'S NOT THE POINT! You can show us the puppy anytime!==W== Right now we need to go to the Tech Convention!==W== Come on, let's go together!
Do you realize I bet my entire fortune on you?! Plus FIVE whole Neo Coins!
Wow, so you really had that much faith in me. Thanks~♪
No need to thank me, just hurry up and come with us...
EHHHHH?! Why not?! You HAVE to go!!
Ever since I received the invitation letter, artisans have been sending me challenge letters every single day.
There were way too many people.==W== I couldn't even blacklist them fast enough. And whenever my mobile workshop stopped for maintenance, they'd come bother me in person too...
I got completely sick of it, so I went to the Soul Shop and deliberately showed the clerk the Neo Grace tube on my phone.
Just like I expected, they immediately contacted the Imperial Guard and brought me to this Hotel.==W== It's so peaceful here~ I absolutely love it~
So you're really ... dead set ... on refusing me...?
Mm-hm. Yep.==W== I came here specifically for some peace, so why would I willingly leave?==W== Besides, Bloc, you're still on my blacklist.
Mm~~ Smells amazing. Rabbit Pie's tea-making skills are pretty impressive.
Bloc's guests have surprisingly good taste. In that case, I'll have Rabbit Pie prepare some mo—
WAIT!?==B====W== H-How do you have ...==W== such an adorable face?!
Hehe~♪==W== Ah, finally... Finally I've found it!==W== The perfect face...==W== The one that inspires me!
Huh? Um... A perfect face? You mean me?
Of course!==W== Ahh, you're so cute...==W== I'm getting so excited I might start bleeding from the nose...♪
... Bloc, you said you bet five Neo Coins on me?
Yes! FIVE! A whole FIVE Neo Coins!!
Then, in exchange for bringing me such wonderful new inspiration, I suppose I can agree to make a deal with you.
I'll take you off my blacklist and go participate in that convention or whatever.==W== Once you win the prize money back, though, all five Neo Coins belong to me.
Deal deal, absolutely deal!==W== Forget five, I'd give you ten if I had to!
Hehe. Every single one of those Neo Coins ...==W== will go toward the new inspiration this adorable young ==SEX13== has given me~
Rabbit Pie, pack everything up. Once we're ready, we're leaving immediately.
Why did she suddenly change her mind?==W== Adorable face? New inspiration? I don't get it at all...==W== Boss, what exactly did you do?
Me? I didn't do anything though?!==W== Is this one of those "all geniuses are weird" situations or something...?
Well, whatever the reason, it worked out great for us!==W== I've already dealt with the guards on the way in, but there might be reinforcements coming soon, so stay close to me, everyone!
